legacy_root.title: Specify the vendor-neutral workflow IR that every acquired workflow is translated into
legacy_root.question: Implementation target: a typed intermediate representation able to express stages, roles, gates, tool policy, fan-out and barriers, loops with convergence rules, human checkpoints, retries, resume, stopping expressions and lineage - expressive enough to round-trip the 10 saved Claude Code workflows losslessly, and explicitly NOT a second execution runtime.
legacy_root.schema_pack_note: WFA-0001's wfa-schema-pack.json is absent on this worktree. This record is a WorkflowIR document validated against the local WFA-0044 schema which still requires source_anchor on every node.

constructs.stage: ordered named phase; maps from phase() and blueprint stg
constructs.role: participant binding on an agent or stage
constructs.gate: blocking or advisory predicate; downgrade to advisory is a defect
constructs.tool_policy: allow/deny tool sets; not a shell runtime
constructs.fanout: parallel dispatch with explicit width; maps from parallel()
constructs.loop: iteration with a named convergence rule and max_iters
constructs.checkpoint: human checkpoint; IR records it, does not prompt a human
constructs.retry: typed retry bound to a failure family
constructs.resume: resume key; IR does not perform resume
constructs.lineage: origin/parent anchors so translation is not anonymous
constructs.agent: one agent() site; dispatch is blocking unless flagged fire_and_forget
constructs.schema_fanin: schema-typed fan-in on a child or join
constructs.lossy: inexpressible construct; required instead of silent drop
constructs.workflow: root; every other node is reachable from it

dialect_map.Date.now(): lossy Date.now; not an IR clock

blueprint_45_field_map.unmapped_native_keys: recorded in the lossy-field ledger; library file is not on disk so keys are not enumerated from records

prior_art.relation: agentspec is a typed Workflow for this estate's runtime. WFA-0044 IR is the vendor-neutral translation target and must not import or execute agentspec.

lossy_field_ledger.reason: wall-clock is a banned non-determinism source; IR has no time primitive
args-as-string is a known saved-workflow defect; prompt is kept, form is flagged
must be flagged, not normalised into a blocking call

This Linux worktree has no ~/.claude/workflows corpus. Round-trip is proven on 10 dialect stand-ins named after the harvest/catalog filenames that are known. Remaining live filenames are UNKNOWN because 08-WORKFLOW-CANDIDATE-REGISTRY.json is also absent.

lossy_field_ledger.construct: closures, statements, and expressions outside the dialect
lossy_field_ledger.reason: IR is not a JS runtime; leftover syntax is lossy, not executed
library file absent; topo/stg/dag/gates/stop are mapped by name, other native keys cannot be enumerated here

corpus.note: WFA-0007/WFA-0042 harvest sampled five wf-saved-* ids; catalog WFA-0045 names plan-gate.mjs and design-gate.mjs. Remaining live filenames are UNKNOWN because 08-WORKFLOW-CANDIDATE-REGISTRY.json and live ~/.claude/workflows are absent on this worktree.

round_trip.equivalence: semantic field-by-field after canonical render, not byte-identical JS
